words:
Love Nov 1 2026 4:27 PM PT: "The rule is only this: - 2-3 PM: flat $25 pink cushion. - Until channel width reaches $100: half the channel width (dollar amount). - From $100 to $180: half the channel width, capped at $60. - Over $180: the normal sliding scale that was already in place. This applies to both BTC and gold. It does not change any other rule. It does not change the unbroken-pink wall. It does not change when a short or long is allowed. It only sets the size of the pink cushion for those hours and widths." + 4:32 PM PT: "gold will be 1/2 of the channel width up until $2 , calculated in distance of price to pink and remain capped at $1.50 until the sliding scale goes back into place at $5."
+ 4:57 PM PT: "its any time the bands are tight and under $180. dont lock it to to any specific time of day" + 5:20 PM PT: "any time bands are under 180 love pls"
what: fix615 the pink cushion size, at any hour, no 2-3 PM number. BTC: half the channel under $100, half capped at $60 from $100 to $180, the normal sliding scale from $180. Gold: half the channel under $2, half capped at $1.50 from $2 to $5, the normal 15% from $5. Measured as price to pink. The unbroken-pink wall and when a short or long is allowed are unchanged. Replaces the fix596 scale and its 2 PM hold.
books: every book that reads the pink cushion but delayed. 5M untouched and off.
